data.body: RP-06 D6.3 approved (2026-08-18): preserve the workflow schema rule usd_budget > 0. Omission/None is the only uncapped spelling. The shared executor must enforce every positive authored code-review budget and record shed units; zero remains invalid and cannot act as an implicit criterion-disable switch. This keeps disabling/applicability in the centralized effective-policy seam and avoids overloading a cost ceiling with control-flow semantics. Updated local evidence: .joe-janitor/rp06-independent-critique.md, rp06-chronology-failure-critique.md, and rp06-review-kernel-research.md. No tracked or production file changed.
